rationale: Validity of a day number is decided entirely by the month-length table the callee returns, and the one non-obvious entry, February, is decided by a leap rule the callee computes from the year, so an error in the callee silently admits or rejects whole classes of dates.

minimum_scope.input_domain: year in [-32767, 32767], month in [1, 12], day in [1, 31], days::rep is a 32-bit int
